scope: Hypothesis predicates operate only on parsed_trace.ordered_events. This file documents those shapes after trace_parser.py. Latency, token, and transfer metrics live elsewhere and are out of scope here.

ordered_events_rules: Array sorted by raw event timestamp (fallback: trace file order).
Each element is one object with exactly one top-level key = event_type.
Only the nine event types listed below appear in ordered_events.
bot_context.tool_events: TOOL_CALL_RESULT and DEBUG.TOOL_INVOKED use the configured tool name as a dynamic JSON key under the event type—not event_value.tool_name or event_value.name.
bot_context.predicate_reference: See hypothesis_ordered_predicate_schema.json and ops.py for event_exists, meta_value_operation, regex, is_ordered_seq_present.

payload.content: User message text (string). Used by regex(user_turn, …).
Final assistant reply text (string). Used by regex(bot_turn, …).

event_value.agent_name: Skill/module that produced the reply (string or null).

TOOL_CALL_RESULT.payload_pattern: Single dynamic key = tool name (e.g. Authenticate_Customer, Make_CC_Payment).

per_tool_entry.result: Object (parsed JSON return). Non-dict JSON may appear as { "_value": … }; decode failures as { "_raw": "…" }.

TOOL_CALL_RESULT.predicate_paths: ["TOOL_CALL_RESULT", "<ToolName>", …] — tool name is required in the path.

DEBUG.TOOL_INVOKED.payload_pattern: Single dynamic key = tool name (from raw name field).

event_value.purpose: Task label, e.g. main_stream, router, input_guardrail (string or null).
event_value.is_tool_call_decision: Boolean or null — true when the model returned tool calls instead of user-visible text.

LLM_INVOCATION_SUCCESS.note: latency_ms / turn_latency_ms from raw logs are not included on the ordered row.

event_value.error_type: Failure class, e.g. timeout (string or null).

event_value.purpose: LLM task whose config was resolved (string or null).
